title: Chasing Butterflies
author: Jim Hemphill
problems: Row 6 "butterfly whirl" can't start from where the dancers are: A butterfly whirl ends on a side; this couple is in the middle.
Row 7 "robins chain" can't start from where the dancers are: The robins must start on opposite sides of the set.
Row 9 "partners balance & swing · swing" can't start from where the dancers are: A swing that ends facing across must start nearer one side.
Row 1 "circle left 3 places" can't start from where the dancers are: A circle of 4 needs the dancers spaced around a ring.
Row 2 "pass through to next neighbors" can't start from where the dancers are: Dancer 0 must face exactly one dancer to pass.
The progression after row 2 "pass through to next neighbors" doesn't work out: Couple 1 must face the same way to find new neighbors.
Row 3 "next neighbors swing" can't start from where the dancers are: A swing that ends facing across must start nearer one side.
Row 9 "partners balance & swing · balance" can't start from where the dancers are: Dancers 0 and 1 are too far apart to balance.
choices: Pass through goes by right shoulders.
A pass through from a ring goes along the set, to the dancer on your own side.
A balance with a partner or neighbor holds both hands.
